steps.en: Clone GOD and start the local stack
steps.zh: 克隆 GOD 并启动本地服务

steps.en: Install dependencies and open the setup wizard
steps.zh: 安装依赖并打开配置向导

steps.en: Supply your model credentials and choose or edit an experiment
steps.zh: 填写模型凭据，选择或编辑实验

steps.en: Create the current town session and record its first step
steps.zh: 创建当前小镇会话，记录第一步

steps.en: Ask residents, issue an intervention, and advance a step
steps.zh: 向居民提问，发出干预，再推进一步

steps.en: Show resident behavior and operator commands in the recorded town
steps.zh: 在小镇记录中显示居民行为与操作者命令

value.en: Inspect how your intervention changes a town without rewriting its driver script
value.zh: 不用重写驱动脚本，就能检查插手后的小镇变化
